title: Data Quality Engineer
summary: Data quality engineers write automated tests that check data as it moves through pipelines, so wrong or missing data is caught before it reaches reports or models. They sit in a data engineering team and work with data owners and analysts.
dailyDuties: Write SQL checks that reconcile source and target data
Build reusable test suites in Python
Add freshness, volume and null checks to pipelines
Run data tests in CI before releases
Investigate failed checks and find the root cause
Report data defects to pipeline owners

skills.expectation: Automate data tests with tools such as Soda, Deequ, dbt tests or Great Expectations
Define data quality rules and profile data
Write complex SQL for reconciliation and validation
Build reusable test frameworks in Python
Test ETL and ELT pipelines end to end
Validate data in Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Synapse
Check large datasets with PySpark or Databricks
Run data tests in CI so bad data blocks releases
Schedule checks in Airflow or similar
Work with data owners on lineage and stewardship
